claimBoundary: Deterministic fixture and agent QA contract; not runtime implementation, observed-user validation, or public-release approval.

rules.title: Source-backed action or explicit user request only.
rules.detail: Supporting method, context, caution and source explanation; not inflated into extra actions.
rules.completion: Typed done condition required for every Item.
rules.schedule: Only a real absolute date, anchor offset, date window or time recurrence. Event trigger alone is not a schedule.
rules.location: User overlay unless the source explicitly owns the location.
rules.fields: Execution or decision state; never re-entry of known source rows.
rules.conditions: Conditional response kept separate from normal completion.
rules.sourceRefs: Required for source-backed Item; explicit user_request provenance is the only source-less exception.

inputOwnership.rule: No two writable layers share a path and source-derived values are never editable inputs.

projectionRules.ics: Generated only from effective scheduled Item occurrences; zero schedule means no ICS object or action.
projectionRules.calendar: Only when date/time is natural to the user job.
projectionRules.checklist: Independent checkable rows, not conditional emergency responses.
projectionRules.todo: A next action or condition-triggered task.
projectionRules.sheet: Row order and persistent progress/record state.
projectionRules.memo: Decision rationale, cautions, references and fallback context.

visibleCopyPolicy.rule: Internal identifiers may exist in application/json data but not in rendered text, accessible names, labels, help, errors, or options.
